description:
The process starts when a company schedules a compliance audit for regulations such as ISO standards, safety protocols, or environmental guidelines.
Internal teams prepare documentation, gather evidence, and conduct a self-assessment before the external audit.
Auditors review the company's processes and identify any gaps or issues.
After making the necessary corrections or improvements, the company undergoes a final audit.
If all criteria are met, the company is awarded certification, and the process concludes with the issuance of official documents.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplianceAudit" name="Compliance Audit and Certification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ComplianceAudit">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditScheduled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareDocumentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherEvidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelfAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MakeCorrections</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Auditor" name="External Auditor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewProcesses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GapsIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CorrectionsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalAudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CriteriaMet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AwardCertification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueOfficialDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Certified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotCertified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review processes and identify gaps or issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GapsIdentified" name="Gaps or issues found?" default="Flow_NoGaps">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GapsFound</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoGaps</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GapsFound</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Corrected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CorrectionsMerge" name="Corrections handled or none needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Corrected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoGaps</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalAudit" name="Undergo final audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="All criteria met?" default="Flow_NotMet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Met</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotMet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Met</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" name="Issue official documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Certified" name="Certification process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotCertified" name="Certification not awarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotMet</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Gateway_GapsIdentified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GapsFound" name="Gaps or issues found" sourceRef="Gateway_GapsIdentified" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGaps" name="No gaps" sourceRef="Gateway_GapsIdentified" targetRef="Gateway_CorrectionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Corrected" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Gateway_CorrectionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_CorrectionsMerge" targetRef="Task_FinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Met" name="All criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotMet" name="Not all criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="EndEvent_NotCertified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="EndEvent_Certified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
